subject: BrightLoop case study: gratitude package, tax receipt and shipping details
messages:
From: Elise Kramer <elise.kramer@brightloop.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T17:12:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightLoop case study participation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again — BrightLoop is happy to be featured. Our comms team is keen; procurement and legal just asked for clarity on what the ‘thank-you package’ looks like and whether we will receive a tax-deductible donation receipt (we route donations through our fiscal sponsor).

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood issue a donation receipt in BrightLoop’s name (or directed to our fiscal sponsor) for any charitable contribution made as part of this? We need a PDF for our records.
- For physical swag: we only need 3 small kits (no single-item values over $75 for our employees). Please confirm whether customs/invoice lines can show ‘marketing thank-you kit’.

Happy to proceed once we have those details.

— Elise
Elise Kramer
Head of Partnerships, BrightLoop
elise.kramer@brightloop.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elise Kramer <elise.kramer@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightLoop case study participation

Elise — great to hear and thanks for the clarity. TL;DR: we can do a $1,000 account credit, a $250 donation routed to STEMForward with a receipt, and 3 small appreciation kits marked as ‘marketing thank-you kit’ for customs.

Details:
- Donation: Redwood will make a $250 donation to STEMForward and we will email you a PDF receipt from our donations team once the gift is processed. If you prefer the donation to be made to your fiscal sponsor, please send the sponsor’s legal name and tax ID and we’ll route accordingly.
- Credit: we’ll apply a $1,000 credit to BrightLoop’s account (apply code on our side) — this will show on your billing as a promotional credit, not an invoice line.
- Swag: the kit is a small canvas tote, one set of stickers, and a printed photobook (no single item >$75). Laura is cc’d to coordinate shipping and customs paperwork.

Attachments: charity_list.pdf (internal reference).

Next steps: Laura will request a shipping address and PO (if your procurement needs a PO for the kits). If procurement requires an invoice for the donation, tell us who to send it to.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Customer Advocate
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightLoop case study participation — shipping / tax notes

Team — looping in logistics/accounting notes before we finalize: 
- Shipping: customs line should read ‘marketing thank-you kit — promotional materials’. Value per kit $60. We will ship DDP (delivered duties paid) from our SF fulfillment partner to avoid surprises.
- Donation paperwork: finance needs recipient legal name + EIN if BrightLoop wants the donation made to their fiscal sponsor; otherwise we will list STEMForward and issue the receipt in Redwood’s name attesting the donation amount and date.
- Photo consent: BrightLoop mentioned a photobook — we need a signed photo_consent_form from participants before publishing. I attached a draft consent form to send to them.

Attachments: customs_value_guidelines.pdf (internal), photo_consent_form.pdf (draft).

Laura Bennett
Operations Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Elise Kramer <elise.kramer@brightloop.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLoop Procurement <procurement@brightloop.ai>
Date: 2026-12-07T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightLoop case study participation

Jonas / Laura — thanks, that all sounds good. Procurement provided the PO (PO-8841) and confirmed the shipping address below. They also confirmed BrightLoop can accept the donation routed to our fiscal sponsor:

Fiscal sponsor: Community Foundations Network
Legal name: Community Foundations Network Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789

Shipping address (for the 3 kits):
BrightLoop HQ
Attn: Elise Kramer
450 Harbor Blvd, Suite 200
Oakland, CA 94607

We also need the donation receipt PDF and a manifest for our records before the kits ship. Will send the signed photo consent forms early next week.

Best,
Elise
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elise Kramer <elise.kramer@brightloop.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightLoop case study participation — final confirmations and receipts

Elise — all set. Summary and artifacts attached:

- Donation: $250 donation issued to Community Foundations Network (fiscal sponsor) on 2026-12-14. Attached: donation_receipt_BrightLoop_20261214.pdf (PDF).
- Shipment: 3 appreciation kits shipped DDP via Redwood Logistics partner. Attached: ship_manifest_20261214.pdf (includes tracking numbers). Expected delivery 2026-12-17. Customs description: "marketing thank-you kit — promotional materials".
- Photo consent: Received your signed photo_consent_form.pdf (thanks). We will exclude any employee who opted out.
- Credit: $1,000 account credit applied to BrightLoop account under deal BL-2026-1394 and will appear on your next billing statement as a promotional credit.

If you need the donation invoice to be routed to a different contact at your fiscal sponsor for their records, let me know. Otherwise, consider this final — super appreciative of BrightLoop participating. Please let me know if you want a short blurb review before the case study goes live.

Attachments: ship_manifest_20261214.pdf, donation_receipt_BrightLoop_20261214.pdf, photo_consent_form.pdf

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Customer Advocate, Redwood Inference
